files.types/index.d.ts:
export type SessionRow = {
  project: string
  id: string
  state: 'ativa' | 'ociosa' | 'encerrada'
  lastActivity: string
  sizeKb: number
}

export type Fleet = {
  totals: { projects: number; sessions: number; active: number; idle: number; sizeMb: number }
  recent: SessionRow[]
  activityByHour: number[]
  topProjects: { project: string; sessions: number }[]
  generatedAt: string
}

/** O que o painel pede a cada 5 s: esta sessão e quantas outras precisam de você (/api/sessao/<id>). */
export type SessionPulse = {
  session: SessionRow | null
  needsYou: number
  generatedAt: string
}

export type IssuePr = { number: number; state: string; isDraft: boolean; url: string; review: string | null; ci: string | null }
export type IssueRow = {
  repo: string
  number: number
  title: string
  url: string
  updatedAt: string
  labels: string[]
  assignees: string[]
  prs: IssuePr[]
  stage: string
}
export type Issues = { total: number; shown: number; byStage: Record<string, number>; items: IssueRow[]; generatedAt: string }

export type Tab = 'sessao' | 'visao' | 'kanban' | 'trabalho' | 'sessoes'

export type Reading = {
  session: SessionPulse | null
  fleet: Fleet | null
  work: Work | null
  kanban: Kanban | null
  error: string | null
  workError: string | null
  kanbanError: string | null
  /** Item do Project sendo movido agora, para o card mostrar que está esperando o GitHub. */
  moving: string | null
  polls: number
  latencies: number[]
}

export type View = {
  tab: Tab
  filter: 'todas' | 'ativa' | 'ociosa' | 'encerrada'
  query: string
  selected: string | null
  stage: string
  org: string
  issueQuery: string
  selectedIssue: string | null
  workMode: 'arvore' | 'estagio' | 'kanban'
  expanded: string[]
  /** Raias do kanban abertas por inteiro, além dos primeiros cards. */
  fullLanes: string[]
}

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'ahrena-console-painel': { reading: Reading; view: View }
  }
}

export type WorkNode = {
  key: string
  repo: string
  number: number
  title: string
  url: string
  state: string
  updatedAt: string
  type: string | null
  rank: number
  progress: { total: number; completed: number; pct: number } | null
  assignees: string[]
  labels: string[]
  prs: IssuePr[]
  stage: string
  parent: string | null
  children: string[]
}
export type Work = { nodes: Record<string, WorkNode>; roots: string[]; byType: Record<string, number>; count: number; generatedAt: string }

// Kanban do GitHub Project (GET /api/kanban): raias na ordem das opções do Status.
export type KanbanCard = {
  itemId: string
  kind: 'Issue' | 'PullRequest' | 'DraftIssue'
  key: string | null
  repo: string | null
  number: number | null
  title: string
  url: string | null
  state: string
  updatedAt: string
  type: string | null
  parent: string | null
  statusId: string | null
}
export type KanbanLane = { id: string | null; name: string; color: string | null; items: KanbanCard[] }
export type Kanban = {
  owner: string
  number: number
  title: string
  url: string
  field: string
  lanes: KanbanLane[]
  count: number
  fetchedAt: number
  stale: boolean
  staleReason: string | null
}
